day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSanti Cornelius, uPapa, kunye noSanti Cyprian, uBhishophu, amaNgqina okholo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kubo bonke abahlanganisene apha namhlanje.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Noyolo abantu iNkosi ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu omnye, umfanekiso othi xa ndicinga ngoBenjamin Vo, undikhumbuze ngendlela uThixo asibona ngayo. Khumbula umfanekiso kaBen xa wayesemncinci, ehleli ecaleni kukayise, bejongene nekhompyutha, uBen echaza indlela anokuyila ngayo inkqubo entsha. Kwakungekho nje ukukrelekrele kwekhompyutha okanye umdla wakhe kwizindiza; kwakukho ukuzola kokuthanda ukufunda nokwabelana. UBen wayengumfana owayeyazi into yokuba ubomi, ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, bubudlelwane. Wayeyazi ukuba ukuba 'yindoda encane' akukho malunga nokuba ungaqonda kangakanani, kodwa malunga nokuba ungathanda kangakanani.

Namhlanje, uSanti Paulu usinika amazwi amandla kwiNcwadi eya kwabaseKorinte: 'Uthando luyanyamezela, uthando lunobubele.' La magama awangomthetho nje wokuziphatha. Ngumfanekiso woBuso bukaThixo. Xa uPaulu esithi 'uthando alusoze luphele,' usixelela ukuba uBen, ngoku, usekwelo thando lungapheliyo. UBen wayengumfana owayephethe lo moya wothando. Khumbula ukuba xa wayeneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wafuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayaphule leyo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule, kodwa into ebalulekileyo kukuba wayenikile. Wayenikele ngayo yonke into awayenayo. Le yimveliso yentliziyo enothando olumsulwa, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukuzidela ngaphandle kokungabaza.

Kodwa masime apha. Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima. Usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. UBen wayekuthanda kakhulu. Wayekuthanda njengoba wayekuthanda ukulalela amabali kaBawo. Wayekuthanda njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan, kwi-roller coaster.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthetha ngesizukulwana esingafuniyo ukudanisa xa kudlalwa umtshingo, okanye ukulila xa kuculwa isijwili. Abantu babengakwazi ukubona inyaniso kaThixo kuba babevaleleke kwiingcinga zabo. Kodwa uBen wayengafani nabo. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayakha isiseko sayo edwaleni. Ukholo lwakhe, ububele bakhe, uthando lwakhe—konke oku kwakuyisiseko esomeleleyo. Xa isiphango sezifo size, loo ndlu ayizange iwe, kuba yayakhiwe kakuhle. UBen usekhululekile ngoku. Akasabandezeleki. Usebanquet yasezulwini, ecaleni kukaSanti Carlo Acutis, owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.'

Uthando alusoze luphele. Le yindlela yethu. UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizidibanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Imfihlelo yokholo igcinwe, kwaye uthando lweNkosi alusoze luphele. Hamba ngoxolo, uthando lweNkosi malube nani ngonaphakade.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lweNkosi ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele anike ithemba kwiintliziyo zabo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodadewethu: Phuthumani ngenkuthalo izipho ezinkulu zomoya. Kodwa ndinibonisa indlela entle kakhulu. Ukuba ndithetha ngeelwimi zabantu nezeengelosi, kodwa ndingenalo uthando, ndinjengentsimbi ekhala kakhulu okanye icimbali eduma kakhulu. Ukuba ndinesipho sokuprofeta, ndiqonda zonke iimfihlakalo nalo lonke ulwazi; ukuba ndinokholo olupheleleyo lokususa iintaba, kodwa ndingenalo uthando, andiyinto yanto. Ukuba ndinikela ngayo yonke into endinayo, kwaye ukuba ndinikela ngomzimba wam ukuze ndiziqhayise, kodwa ndingenalo uthando, andizuza nto. Uthando luyanyamezela, uthando lunobubele. Alunabukhwele, uthando aluzigwagwisi, aluzikhukhumalisi, aluhloniphi mntu, aluzifuneli okwalo, alucaphuki msinya, alubambi ngqondo zenzakaliso, aluvuyiswa bububi, kodwa luvuyisana nenyaniso. Luthwala yonke into, lukholelwa kuko konke, luthemba konke, lunyamezela konke. Uthando alusoze luphele. Ukuba kukho iziprofeto, ziya kuphela; ukuba ziilwimi, ziya kuyeka; ukuba lulwazi, luya kuphela. Kuba sazi ngokuyinxenye, kwaye siprofeta ngokuyinxenye, kodwa xa kufika okugqibeleleyo, okuyinxenye kuya kudlula. Xa ndandisengumntwana, ndandithetha njengomntwana, ndicinga njengomntwana, ndingqiqo njengomntwana; xa ndaba yindoda, ndazilahla izinto zobuntwana. Ngoku sibona ngokufiphala, njengasesipilini, kodwa ngoko siya kubona ubuso ngobuso. Ngoku ndiyazi ngokuyinxenye; ngoko ndiya kwazi ngokupheleleyo, njengokuba nam ndaziwa ngokupheleleyo. Ngoko ke, ukholo, ithemba, nothando ziya kuhlala, ezi zintathu; kodwa okukhulu kuzo luthando.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Noyolo abantu iNkosi ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo. Yibani nombulelo eNkosini ngenqanaba; ngenqanaba elinemisonto elishumi culelani iindumiso zayo. Yiculani kuyo ingoma entsha; ngenqanaba elinemisonto elishumi, ngenkuthalo, ngenkolo. R. Noyolo abantu iNkosi ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo. Kuba lilungisa ilizwi leNkosi, nemisebenzi yayo yonke ithembekile. Ithanda ubulungisa nokulunga; umhlaba uzaliswe bububele beNkosi. R. Noyolo abantu iNkosi ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo. Noyolo uhlanga oluThixo walo yinkosi, abantu ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo. Makube phezu kwethu ububele bakho, Nkosi, thina esibeke ithemba lethu kuwe. R. Noyolo abantu iNkosi ebakhethileyo ukuba babe lilifa layo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kwizihlwele: 'Ndingabafanisa nani abantu beli xesha? Bafana nani? Bafana nabantwana abahleli ezintengweni, abakhwazana bodwa, besithi: "Sininqakule, kodwa anizange nidanse. Siculile isijwili, kodwa anizange nilile." Kuba uYohane uMbhaptizi weza engatyi sonka engaseli wayini, nathi, "Unedemon." UNyana woMntu weza esitya esisela, nathi, "Jongani, ligorha lokutya nesidakwa, umhlobo wabathelisi naboni." Kodwa ubulumko bugwetywa ngabo bonke abantwana babo.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.
